defs.meaning: 柯林斯（姓氏名）；柯林斯酒

examples.en: Collins was in a foul mood even before the interviews began.
examples.zh: 柯林斯甚至在面试开始之前就处于暴躁情绪。

examples.en: Last year Collins wrote a moving ballad which highlighted the plight of the homeless.
examples.zh: 去年柯林斯写了一首感人的叙事诗，突出描写了无家可归者的苦境。

examples.en: You don't get much more new to acting than Lily Collins.
examples.zh: 你不会比莉莉·柯林斯对表演有更多的了解。
